name: io.github.matinfo-tech/markdown-pdf-export
title: Markdown PDF Export
description: Markdown to PDF with your header, footer, page numbers and logo. Pages designed in Studio.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_PDF_SETTINGS
environmentVariables.description: Settings file to use instead of ~/.config/markdown-pdf-export/settings.json, or settings as JSON

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_PDF_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Browser that draws the PDF: chrome, msedge, chromium, or a path to a browser program

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_PDF_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to write a debug log to markdown-pdf-debug.log in the temp folder
